config.label: AEP DOE public environmental-review index — September 30, 2026 snapshot
config.publisher: United States Department of Energy, Office of Energy Dominance Financing
config.processAuthority: DOE environmental review within the Energy Dominance Financing process

manifestSource.locator: All eight featured AEP review entries captured September 30, 2026; two public consultation letters provide supplemental evidence, not extra records

config.geographicScope: Three named Ohio and five named Texas scopes; finite public review subset, not complete state, AEP or regional coverage.
config.inventoryScope: Eight named physical transmission scopes from the captured DOE AEP review index: seven line rebuild upgrades and one station project. Supplemental consultations do not add projects.
limitations: Complete enumeration refers only to the eight-entry public featured/funding-review index snapshot, not all AEP projects or net-new projects beyond PJM/ERCOT.
All lifecycle values are planned at the readable signed-letter date. Review completion is neither construction/service completion nor financing approval or engineering feasibility.
Index posting, signed review, anticipated start and anticipated operation dates are separate meanings. Snapshot retrieval and generatedAt do not update project status.
Ohio operation forecasts retain exact day precision; all five Texas operation dates are unknown. Forecast starts are supplemental and do not establish actual construction bounds.
East Munday uses May 8 public consultation text. The later indexed PDF is image-only; its signed date and body were not interpreted. King Ranch voltage uses June 16 public matching-scope evidence.
AEP applicant and index affiliate labels do not establish legal asset owners. All owners remain unknown.

All locations, native geometry and construction bounds remain unknown. Named counties/endpoints, route lengths, right-of-way widths and station areas do not supply project centers or shared-corridor estimates.

review-001 through review-008 are frozen source-document locators, not native engineering IDs. Future index reordering requires an explicit crosswalk. Shared consultation codes and similar RTO names do not authorize merging or field transfers.

Only concise factual paraphrases and public citations are derived. No original files, personal contact fields, restricted attachments, image interpretation or asserted open/commercial reuse license are included.
